visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a blue graphic, stands in front of a recessed shelving unit. The shelves contain three YouTube creator awards (Gold and Silver) and multiple character figurines like cats and mushrooms. (2) He puts a green camouflage military-style cap on his head and holds a long, brown cylindrical cardboard tube. He points his finger at the camera while speaking. (3) He unrolls a large black paper scroll with large, golden-ink Chinese calligraphy characters. He holds it up with both hands in front of the awards. (4) He is then shown lying on the floor next to the scroll in a 'relaxed' pose, resting his head on his hand. Animated lens flares and sparkles are superimposed over the scene. (5) The camera moves into extreme close-ups of the scroll, showing a red ink stamp with traditional script and the golden texture of the hand-painted characters '大展鴻圖' and smaller text on the side. (6) He moves to a living room with a large off-white sectional sofa and wood-slat wall panels. He holds the banner against the wall, positioning it above the sofa. (7) The final shot is a close-up of his face as he stares directly at the camera with a neutral, expectant expression against a blurred background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic male voice shouting '15' followed by a sharp 'to'. This is immediately punctuated by a heavy, percussive 'thud' sound as a package strikes a hard surface. The background ambience is a very clean studio silence. (2) The male speaker continues with a rapid, conversational narration in Traditional Chinese, explaining the receipt of a package from a friend in prison. His voice has high pitch variability, indicating excitement or humor. (3) As the scroll is unrolled, a rhythmic rap-style music track begins with a strong, synthesized drum beat (BPM approx 120). The male vocals on the track sing the phrase 'Da Zhan Hong Tu' in a stylized, meme-like cadence. (4) Each time the speaker mentions a specific character on the scroll, a light digital 'ding' or 'pop' sound effect is heard, emphasizing the visual identification. (5) The main vocal tone shifts to a slightly more ironic or teasing quality while explaining the origin of the gift. The music continues in a loop with persistent percussion. (6) Towards the end, the speaker asks a question with rising intonation. This is met with a dry, low-arousal female voice saying 'Chai diao' (Take it down) followed by an immediate, abrupt cut in all audio levels.

The intent is to entertain through the contrast between the traditional, auspicious calligraphy and its unusual source, capped with a humorous rejection by an unseen female companion.
